title: Stop Killing Games Urges No Support for GTA6 Leakers
description: Consumer rights movement Stop Killing Games has released a public statement admonishing the group responsible for leaking GTA6 gameplay footage.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Stop Killing Games Admonishes GTA6 Leakers

The ongoing anticipation surrounding Grand Theft Auto 6 has taken another controversial turn. According to a report by gaming media outlet Eurogamer on August 19, 2026, the consumer rights movement Stop Killing Games has issued a public statement addressing the recent actions of the group that claimed responsibility for leaking GTA6 gameplay footage overnight.

## The Controversy Over 'Gamers' Rights'

Reports indicate that the group behind the leak attempted to justify their actions by declaring "gamers' rights" as their primary motive. However, this rationale has faced significant pushback from advocacy groups and the wider gaming community. Stop Killing Games, an organization typically known for pushing back against practices that render games unplayable, stepped forward to explicitly admonish the actions of the leakers and urged the public not to support them.

Industry analysis suggests that while enthusiasm for GTA6 remains at an all-time high, crossing ethical and legal lines through unauthorized leaks damages the development ecosystem. By drawing a clear line between legitimate consumer advocacy and illicit data leaking, Stop Killing Games highlights the importance of respecting industry standards.

## Editor's Take

True consumer advocacy is built on principles of fairness and respect, not on unauthorized leaks and the violation of development boundaries. Stop Killing Games' stance is a timely reminder that supporting GTA6 shouldn't come at the cost of supporting disruptive and unlawful actions.
